summary: The Data Site Reliability Engineer (SRE) applies software engineering principles to build highly reliable, scalable, and automated data platforms and services.
responsibilities: Design and implement highly reliable and scalable data systems
Build automation for deployment, scaling, and monitoring
Ensure SLA/SLO compliance for data pipelines and services
Troubleshoot complex operational issues and system failures
Collaborate with data engineers and platform teams to improve reliability

education: 5–8 years of experience in SRE or reliability engineering for data systems

skills_required.name: Expertise in distributed systems and cloud platforms
Monitoring, alerting, and observability (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog)
